meta.name: Workforce Planner look
meta.notes: One source for the app, deck, report and notebook (D-26). Colors are hex, sizes are px (deck: pt = px * 0.75). Each entry is {value, use}. Read design/README.md before adding a role. Generated from this file: web/src/styles/tokens.css (node scripts/build_tokens.mjs).

canvas.use: Page background behind cards. On slides: not used (content slides are white).

surface.use: Cards, tables, chart plots, the drawer, white slides.

raised.use: A panel set on a card: table header rows, row hover, inset callouts, code blocks. On slides: callout box fill.

border.use: Hairline card and table borders, dividers.

border_strong.use: Control outlines (inputs, unselected segments), focus-free emphasis lines.

ink.use: Primary text and big numbers. 17.3:1 on surface.

ink_muted.use: Secondary text: answer sentences, descriptions, table body. 7.6:1 on surface.

ink_subtle.use: Tertiary text: labels, captions, axis ticks. >= 4.5:1 on surface, raised and canvas.

accent.use: Iris. The plan in every chart, links, selected states, primary buttons, focus rings. 6.3:1 on white. Clearly not Costco red (#E31837) or blue (#005DAA).

accent_strong.use: Accent hover/pressed, accent text on accent_soft.

accent_soft.use: Light accent: selected rows and segments, the active nav wash, plan area fills.

accent_line.use: Border of accent_soft panels and chips.

on_accent.use: Text and icons on an accent fill.

plan.use: The recommended plan, always. Same as accent.

draft.use: The manager's draft schedule, always neutral gray, solid. 3.0:1 on white, so draft marks carry labels or a table.

draft_soft.use: Draft bar fills behind a plan bar, draft area fills.

benchmark.use: The case's naive benchmark forecast, always a dashed gray line (see chart.benchmark_dash).

good.use: Status: meets the service goal. Icons and marks. Always with an icon and a label.

good_ink.use: Status text on good_soft or white (5.4:1 on good_soft).

warning.use: Status: thin cushion or high utilization (0.85 to 0.90). Icons and marks, never text (2.5:1).

warning_ink.use: Warning text on warning_soft or white (5.8:1 on warning_soft).

risk.use: Status: below the service goal, over capacity, errors. Icons, markers, badges.

risk_soft.use: Status chip fill for risk, error panels.

risk_ink.use: Risk text on risk_soft or white (5.5:1 on risk_soft).

dept_front_end.use: Front End (cerulean). Series marks, dots and rules only; text stays in ink.

dept_merchandising.use: Merchandising (bronze, like cardboard and pallets). Series marks only.

navy.use: App frame (top bar and sidebar), title/demo/closing slides, chart tooltips.

navy_raised.use: Hover and active items on navy, controls on navy.

navy_border.use: Dividers and control outlines on navy.

navy_ink_muted.use: Secondary text and icons on navy (9.0:1).

navy_accent.use: Accent on navy: the active nav indicator, the logo's lit cells (7.0:1).

focus.use: 2px focus ring, offset 2px. On navy use navy_accent.

chance.use: Sequential, one hue (iris), light to dark = higher chance of meeting the service target. For board cells and heatmaps; every cell also prints its number, so the light end may recede toward the surface (palette.md rule for sequential fills).

change.use: Diverging, change in headcount vs the draft. Bronze-orange arm = fewer people than the draft, iris arm = more, gray midpoint = no change. Cells always print the signed number.

departments.use: Fixed order and fixed hue per department. Validated with the dataviz validator, all pairs, light mode, on #FFFFFF and #F3F5F8: worst CVD dE 10.3 (deutan, Front End vs Pharmacy), worst normal-vision dE 20.9, all >= 3:1.

family_ui.value: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif

family_display.value: 'Segoe UI Variable Display', 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif
family_display.use: App page titles and KPI values (the Display optical size).

family_office.use: Deck, Word file and matplotlib charts (one family name, no stack).

family_mono.use: Command snippets in error screens only.

weight_bold.use: Rare: the hero number on a slide.

size_label.use: The floor. Captions, axis ticks, chips, table headers. Nothing in the app is smaller.

size_body.use: Default body text, table cells, controls.

size_lead.use: The answer sentence under a page title.

size_hero.use: One hero number per view (slides mostly).

line_relaxed.use: Long explanations in the drawer and Methods.

numeric.use: Tables, axis ticks, deltas and board cells, so columns line up.

radius_frame.use: The canvas corner where it meets the navy frame; the drawer's leading edge.

focus_width.use: Focus rings and the board's selected-cell ring.

space.use: Spacing steps. Card padding 20, page gutter 32, gap between cards 16 to 24.

card.use: Cards: a border plus this barely-there shadow.

raised.use: Drawer, popovers, tooltips, the preparing card.

label.use: Direct labels on lines and bars (ink_muted).

band.use: Shaded spans: Valentine's Day, the holiday window, PEAK's surge. Labeled in text.

line_width_plan.use: The plan line when it shares a chart with draft or benchmark, px.

marker_size.use: Marker diameter, px, with a 2px surface-colored ring.

bar_max_width.use: Bars never thicker than this, px.

bar_radius.use: Rounded data end; square at the baseline.

bar_gap.use: Surface gap between touching bars and stacked segments, px.

axis_from_zero.use: Bar and column axes always start at zero (F-60).
